meta.notes: No new items found this cycle. 17 entries aged out of the 12-month "recent" window. Could not complete research for: us-east-central, us-south-west, canada.

updates.title: PJM Manual 14H – New Service Requests Cycle Process
updates.summary: Rev. 07; now the consolidated governing manual for generation & transmission interconnection requests (absorbed M14A/M14E), revised for FERC Docket ER26-5-000 to drop the "first use" jurisdictional test.

updates.title: PJM Manual 14A – New Services Request Process (retired)
updates.summary: Formally retired; contents merged into Manual 14H.

updates.title: PJM Manual 14E – Upgrade & Transmission Interconnection Requests (retired)
updates.summary: Retired concurrently with Manual 14A; folded into Manual 14H.

updates.title: PJM Manual 14B – Regional Transmission Planning Process
updates.summary: Rev. 59; governs RTEP studies including load/generator deliverability, N-1/N-1-1, short-circuit and stability analysis (Attachment G).

updates.title: PJM Manual 14D – Generator Operational Requirements
updates.summary: Rev. 71; generator market/operational obligations.

updates.title: Replacement Generation Interconnection Service (RGIS)
updates.summary: New expedited process transferring Capacity Interconnection Rights from deactivating units to same-POI replacements.

updates.title: PJM Manual 14G – Generation Interconnection Requests
updates.summary: Rev. 8; baseline document for the GI study/agreement process (feasibility, impact, facilities studies) — under active Planning Committee discussion for consolidation.

updates.title: Attachment X – Generator Interconnection Procedures (GIP)
updates.summary: Tariff baseline governing the Definitive Planning Phase queue process (System Impact and Facilities Studies).

updates.title: FERC filing, Docket ER26-677
updates.summary: Refined Attachment X revisions for the Expedited Resource Addition Study (ERAS) after stakeholder pushback.

updates.title: FERC order on 2nd Order 2023/2023-A compliance filing
updates.summary: FERC accepted MISO's Attachment X compliance filing in part and ordered a further compliance filing.

updates.title: MISO further compliance filing (Order 2023/2023-A)
updates.summary: Response to the March 2026 FERC order, further amending Attachment X queue-reform provisions.

updates.title: BPM-015 – Generation Interconnection Business Practices Manual
updates.summary: Operational detail supplementing Attachment X: short-circuit, stability, and DPP-phase study procedures.

updates.title: Generation Interconnection Application Portal transition
updates.summary: Legacy application portal decommissioned; all interconnection activity moved to the new Generation Interconnection Application Portal.

updates.title: Manual 23 – Transmission Expansion & Interconnection (TEI) Manual
updates.summary: Principal manual translating LFIP/SGIP tariff rules into study and engineering procedures (v4.3).

updates.title: OATT Attachment X – Standard Large Facility Interconnection Procedures
updates.summary: Docket ER21-1001; baseline large-facility interconnection procedures.

updates.title: OATT Attachment Z – Small Generator Interconnection Procedures
updates.summary: Baseline small-generator (≤20MW) interconnection procedures.

updates.title: Order 2023/2023-A compliance filing
updates.summary: Docket ER24-1915; revised interconnection tariff sections for FERC's interconnection reform rule.

updates.title: Large Load Interconnection Process reform (stakeholder track)
updates.summary: Major proposed tariff/manual revisions addressing large-load interconnection and reliability; FERC filing targeted for December 2026.

updates.title: Technical Bulletin 266
updates.summary: Supplemental procedures for the Load Interconnection System Impact Study.

updates.title: OATT Schedule 22 – Large Generator Interconnection Procedures
updates.summary: Baseline Large Generator Interconnection Procedures, including the pro forma LGIA.

updates.title: OATT Schedule 23 – Small Generator Interconnection Procedures
updates.summary: Baseline Small Generator Interconnection Procedures.

updates.title: Order 2023/2023-A compliance filing
updates.summary: Docket ER24-2007; proposed Schedule 22/23/Attachment K revisions with independent-entity variations for FERC's interconnection reform.

updates.title: Further compliance filing (Order 2023/2023-A)
updates.summary: Additional Schedule 22/23 revisions after FERC found the first compliance filing only partially compliant.

updates.title: Tariff revisions establishing DER participation service
updates.summary: Establishes a tariff service framework for distributed energy resource participation, adjacent to interconnection rules.

updates.title: Planning Procedure PP3 – Reliability Standards
updates.summary: Rev. 8; interconnection performance/reliability standards referenced by generation study procedures.

updates.title: OATT Attachment V — Generator Interconnection Procedures (2nd compliance filing)
updates.summary: FERC accepted SPP's second compliance filing revising Attachment V (GIP) to implement Order Nos. 2023/2023-A interconnection queue reforms (first-ready-first-served, financial deposits, co-location, surplus interconnection).

updates.title: Order Nos. 2023/2023-A compliance filing (initial), Docket ER24-2026-000
updates.summary: SPP's original FERC filing proposing GIP tariff changes to comply with FERC Order 2023; later followed by a further compliance filing after partial acceptance.

updates.title: GI Manual Business Practice
updates.summary: Version 4.4 business-practice manual detailing how SPP administers GIP studies (DISIS phases, feasibility/impact studies).

updates.title: SPP Planning Criteria, Revision 4.6
updates.summary: Governing planning/reliability criteria (thermal, voltage, stability limits) used in interconnection and transmission studies; supersedes Rev. 4.5.

updates.title: FERC order approving SPP's Consolidated Planning Process
updates.summary: FERC approved SPP's restructuring of its transmission planning process, consolidating processes relevant to interconnection/system studies.

updates.title: ERCOT Nodal Protocols (current)
updates.summary: Monthly-updated master protocol document; Section 3 governs generator interconnection requirements/process.

updates.title: NPRR1234 – Interconnection requirements for large loads & modeling standards ≥25 MW
updates.summary: Establishes new interconnection/modeling requirements for large loads (e.g. data centers), folding them into stability/reliability assessments before energization. Effective 2025-12-15.

updates.title: PGRR115 – Large Load Interconnection Study (LLIS) process
updates.summary: Creates a new Large Load Interconnection Study process in the Planning Guide requiring large loads to be studied for stability/reliability impacts before interconnection. Effective 2025-12-15.

updates.title: PGRR120 – Sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) risk reduction for generator interconnection
updates.summary: Adds sub-synchronous oscillation risk screening/mitigation requirements to generator interconnection studies in the Planning Guide.

updates.title: NPRR1267 – Monthly large load interconnection status report
updates.summary: Requires ERCOT to publish a recurring public status report tracking large-load interconnection queue progress.

updates.title: ERCOT Planning Guide (current)
updates.summary: Baseline planning/study-methodology document (transmission and generation study criteria), updated monthly to fold in approved PGRRs.

updates.title: Appendix DD – Generator Interconnection & Deliverability Allocation Procedures (GIDAP)
updates.summary: Current governing large-generator interconnection tariff appendix (queue clustering, deliverability allocation), reflecting Track 3 reforms.

updates.title: Appendix S – Small Generator Interconnection Procedures (SGIP)
updates.summary: Governs interconnection of generating facilities ≤20 MW; FERC's May 2025 order accepted CAISO's Order 2023/2023-A SGIP compliance filing in part and required a further filing.

updates.title: Interconnection Process Enhancements 2023 – Track 3 (Docket ER25-2044)
updates.summary: FERC accepted CAISO's Track 3 interconnection reforms (queue/study process refinements), following Track 1/2 reforms effective Oct 1, 2024.

updates.title: Tariff amendment – Interconnection Process Enhancements 5 (Docket ER26-2747)
updates.summary: Newest FERC filing continuing CAISO's iterative interconnection-process reform track.

updates.title: Section 24 – Comprehensive Transmission Planning Process (Tariff)
updates.summary: Governs annual transmission planning studies (reliability, deliverability, policy-driven) that interconnection facilities/system-impact studies rely on.

updates.title: CAISO Planning Standards
updates.summary: Baseline reliability/planning standards (thermal, voltage, stability) above NERC/WECC minimums, used in interconnection studies.

updates.title: Market Rules Chapter 4 – Grid Connection Requirements
updates.summary: Core rulebook chapter setting connection/registration requirements for facilities connecting to the IESO-controlled grid; current at Baseline 55.1.

updates.title: Market Manual 1, Part 0.1.4 – Connection Assessment and Approval (MAN-129)
updates.summary: Governs the connection assessment/approval process (system impact & feasibility assessments); recently reorganized and rewritten for clarity.

updates.title: Ontario Resource and Transmission Assessment Criteria (ORTAC), Issue 6.0
updates.summary: Sets the reliability/planning criteria (thermal, voltage, stability) IESO uses for transmission and resource-adequacy assessments, including connection-related studies.

updates.title: Updates to performance requirements – Market Rule Appendices 4.2 & 4.3 (engagement)
updates.summary: Ongoing stakeholder process to revise DER/inverter-based-resource performance requirements to align with NERC PRC-024-3 and CSA 22.3 No.9; not yet finalized.

updates.title: OEB decision on Market Renewal Program (MRP) market rule amendments
updates.summary: OEB reviewed and did not overturn IESO Board-approved MRP market rule amendments; shows the active OEB oversight channel used for chapter/appendix changes.

updates.title: ISO Rules, Section 5 – Connections
updates.summary: Governing rules for connection of generation/load facilities to the Alberta interconnected electric system, filed with and approved by the AUC.

updates.title: AESO Connection Process & Quick Reference Guide
updates.summary: Describes the staged application/study/regulatory process (scoping, system access service, construction) generators and loads must follow to connect.

updates.title: Amendments for the AESO Tariff – Connection Process (stakeholder engagement)
updates.summary: AESO is updating ISO tariff Sections 3, 5 and 6 (System Access Service agreements, Construction Commitment Agreements, security/PILON provisions); AUC filing expected Q3 2026.

updates.title: Connection requirements for transmission-connected data centres (TCDC)
updates.summary: New technical/study requirements specifically for large transmission-connected data centre loads, to be embedded into ISO Rules and Alberta Reliability Standards.

updates.title: AESO 2025 Reliability Requirements Roadmap
updates.summary: Sets out new/updated reliability requirements (system strength/weighted short-circuit ratio screening, flexibility, frequency response) feeding into connection studies.

updates.title: Technical Requirements for the Connection of Generating Stations to the Hydro-Québec Transmission System
updates.summary: Core technical requirements for connecting generating facilities (hydraulic, thermal, wind, solar, storage) at 44 kV and above.

updates.title: Standard E.12-01 – Technical requirements for distributed generation interconnection to the HQ distribution system
updates.summary: Sets minimum technical requirements for interconnecting distributed/self-generation (including certified inverters ≤100 kW) to the medium/low-voltage distribution system.

updates.title: Transmission System Modeling Data Requirements and Reporting Procedures (v6)
updates.summary: Specifies the modeling data (short-circuit, dynamic/stability models) generators and other interconnecting parties must submit to support TransÉnergie's system studies.

updates.title: R-4270-2024 – Transmission/distribution rate and conditions case, Phase 4
updates.summary: Régie de l'énergie proceeding setting HQ Transmission Provider's rates/conditions of service, touching planning and reliability-framework compliance matters relevant to connection tariff terms.

updates.title: Rate review applications R-4305-2025 & R-4306-2025 (2026-2028)
updates.summary: New Régie de l'énergie filings for 2026-2028 rates covering both the Transmission Provider and Distributor; baseline procedural filings to watch for connection-tariff redlines.

updates.title: 60 kV to 500 kV Technical Interconnection Requirements for Power Generators
updates.summary: Revision 2.1.1; governs technical (voltage, frequency, protection, ride-through) requirements for transmission-level generator interconnections.

updates.title: Technical Interconnection Requirements for Voltage Customers, 60 kV–287 kV
updates.summary: Companion technical standard for non-generator transmission-voltage interconnecting customers.

updates.title: Transmission System Studies Guide
updates.summary: Describes the system-impact and facilities-study process/methodology (impact studies ~6-9 months, facilities studies ~3-4 months) for new transmission connections.

updates.title: OATT generator interconnection amendments (BCUC Application 976)
updates.summary: BCUC proceeding on BC Hydro's proposed amendments to OATT Attachment M-1/M-2 (Standard Generator Interconnection Procedures) governing the queue, application, and study process.

updates.title: Site Control Criteria
updates.summary: Sets site-control documentation requirements applicants must meet at each stage of the interconnection queue.
